description: Mapping of NIDAP JSON keys to SCWorkflow R function parameters

object_input_rds.description: a list of seurat objects for each sample

npcs.description: Select the number of principal components for your analysis. Please see the elbow plot in the previous template to figure out what number of PCs explains your variance cut-off

sct_level.description: Select at which stage to apply SCtransform nomalization. Merged: Merge all samples and apply SCTransfrom on merged object. Sample: Apply SCTranform on individual samples then merge into single Seurat object

vars_to_regress.description: Subtract ('regress out') this source of heterogeneity from the data. For example, to Subtract mitochondrial effects, input "percent.mt." Options: percent.mt, nCount.RNA, S.Score, G2M.Score, CC.Difference

low_cut.description: Set low cutoff to calculate feature means in Seurat::FindVariableFeatures

high_cut.description: Set high cutoff to calculate feature means in Seurat::FindVariableFeatures

low_cut_disp.description: Set low cutoff to calculate feature dispersions in Seurat::FindVariableFeatures

high_cut_disp.description: Set high cutoff to calculate feature dispersions in Seurat::FindVariableFeatures

selection_method.description: Method to choose top variable features. Options: vst, mean.var.plot, dispersion

only_var_genes.description: If dataset is larger than ~40k filtered cells, set to TRUE. If TRUE, only variable genes will be available for downstream analysis

seed_for_pca.description: Set a random seed for PCA calculation

seed_for_tsne.description: Set a random seed for TSNE calculation

seed_for_umap.description: Set a random seed for UMAP calculation

clust_res_low.description: Select minimum resolution for clustering plots. The lower you set this, the FEWER clusters will be generated

clust_res_high.description: Select the maximum resolution for clustering. The higher you set this number, the MORE clusters you will produced

clust_res_bin.description: Select the bins for your cluster plots. For example, if you input 0.2 as your bin, and have low/high resolution ranges of 0.2 and 0.6, then the template will produce cluster plots at resolutions of 0.2, 0.4 and 0.6

methods_pca.description: Methods available: Marchenko-Pastur: use eigenvalue null upper bound from URD, Elbow: Find threshold where percent change in variation between consecutive PCs is less than X% (set in var.threshold)

var_threshold.description: For Elbow method, set percent change threshold in variation between consecutive PCs

jackstraw.description: Opt to visualize your data in a Jackstraw plot. Jackstraw plot can add more description than an elbow plot but is compute intensive process and may not be suitable for larger datasets

pca_reg_plot.description: Opt to visualize the effect of your regression variables on in a PCA plot. This plot will create PCA plots with and without regression variables applied

exclude_sample.description: Exclude unwanted samples from the merge step. Include sample names to be removed. If you want to exclude several samples, separate each sample number by comma

project_name.description: Add project name to the Seurat object metadata

cell_hashing_data.description: Set to "TRUE" if you are using cell-hashed data

cell_count_limit.description: If total number of cell exceeds this limit conserve memory option of SCTransform will be used and return only Variable Genes

reduce_so.description: Remove any additional assays from input Seurat Objects except for the original RNA Assay. This option should be used if input Seurat Object was created outside of the NIDAP pipeline

object_input_rds.description: A dataset containing your SingleR annotated/merged seurat object

category_to_filter.description: What kind of metadata you want to subset by. This should be one column in your Metadata table

values_to_filter.description: One or more values where you want to filter

keep_or_remove.description: TRUE to filter down to selected values, FALSE to filter out selected values

greater_less_than.description: Decide if you want to keep cells above or below the threshold

cut_off.description: The cut-off you want to use for your greater than/less than filter

legend_position.description: Select "none" if legend takes up too much space in plot

reduction.description: What kind of clustering visualization you would like to use for summary plot (umap, tsne, pca, protein_tsne, protein_umap, protein_pca)

plot_as_interactive_plot.description: TRUE for interactive, FALSE for static

dot_size.description: Size of dots on TSNE/UMAP projection plot

number_of_legend_columns.description: If legend is too long, provide more legend columns

dot_size_highlighted_cells.description: Dot size for cells in the after-filter plot which have been highlighted

use_cite_seq_data.description: TRUE if you would like to plot Antibody clusters from CITEseq instead of scRNA

object_input_rds.description: The input Seurat Object or list of Seurat Objects to which you wish to add metadata

metadata_to_append.description: A table of sample metadata that you want to append to the already-existing metadata within the input Seurat Object(s)

sample_name_column.description: The column of the input metadata.to.append table that contains sample names matching the orig.idents in the input object(s)
